sources.summary: In response to the lack of educational infrastructure in Ancón , the Cotacero team, in collaboration with volunteers and the local community, led the design and construction of the Nido Linaje de David II, a 500 m² project that will benefit more than 450 children. The main inspiration and conceptual foundation was the urgent need to provide a dignified and stimulating environment for early childhood learning in a district with very limited resources. Rooted in the idea of architecture as a tool for social transformation, the project integrates sustainability, flexibility, and community engagement as its key drivers.
